title: The Orientation Intervention to Rapid Response Teams (ORIENT-RRT) Study: A Quasi-Experimental Study
official: The Orientation Intervention to Rapid Response Teams (ORIENT-RRT) Study: A Quasi-Experimental Study
summary: This study will measure knowledge, confidence, and nursing practice outcomes related to the effectiveness and feasibility of a 12-hour educational clinical intervention for NGNs during orientation.

interventions.name: Orientation day with rapid response nurse

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* New graduate nurses hired onto an acute care unit at University of Colorado Hospital, Medical Center of the Rockies, and Poudre Valley Hospital

Exclusion Criteria:

* New graduate nurses who are not employed on an acute care unit at the three study hospital at UCHealth
* New graduate nurses who have completed clinical orientation or started orientation prior to this study commencing
